episodeTitle: India has sat on the Security Council eight times

prompt.en: How many times has India been an elected member of the UN Security Council?
prompt.hi: भारत कितनी बार संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद का निर्वाचित सदस्य रहा है?

takeaway.en: India has also been among the largest contributors of UN peacekeepers, a point often made for a permanent seat.
takeaway.hi: भारत संयुक्त राष्ट्र शांति सैनिक भेजने वाले सबसे बड़े देशों में भी रहा है, जिसे स्थायी सीट के पक्ष में अक्सर कहा जाता है।

sources: United Nations Security Council, 'Countries elected members' (un.org/securitycouncil)
Ministry of External Affairs, India at the UNSC 2021–22 (mea.gov.in)

review.note: Written by Claude from the listed sources, 14 Nov 2026. Hindi by Claude. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor.
